decision: Run a small pilot of an automated livestock water-refill system.
purpose: Reduce repetitive refill labor while preserving animal access to water and manual fallback.

hard_constraints.label: Animals must retain reliable water access
hard_constraints.evidence: Synthetic design includes existing manual trough fill as fallback during pilot.

hard_constraints.label: Installation must meet applicable electrical/safety requirements
hard_constraints.evidence: Synthetic example has not yet received contractor/code review.

hard_constraints.label: Automation failure must not remove the operator's ability to supply water manually
hard_constraints.evidence: Synthetic design retains manual valve/fill route.

hard_constraints.label: Pilot must not create unacceptable overflow/waste
hard_constraints.evidence: Synthetic float-valve failure behavior has not yet been observed.

viability.financial: Modeled labor savings exist in the synthetic scenario, but purchase/payback analysis is deferred until the gate clears.
viability.operational: Small pilot is feasible because the existing manual system remains available.
viability.legal: Applicable installation requirements have not yet been verified in this synthetic case.
viability.technical: Components are conceptually simple but failure behavior still needs testing.
viability.biological_ecological: Reliable animal water access is protected by fallback; overflow/water-waste behavior remains uncertain.

reciprocity: Potentially returns repetitive chore time to the operator while preserving water access; water waste must be checked.
enoughness: The synthetic target is to reduce refill labor enough to remove a recurring bottleneck, not to maximize automation coverage across the entire farm.
wider_system_effects: Possible reduced labor burden; possible water waste if failure modes are not controlled.

reversibility.note: Pilot can be removed and the existing manual watering method retained.

review_trigger: Re-evaluate after qualified installation review and a short observed pilot confirms failure behavior and water-use performance.
evidence_notes: Synthetic demonstration only; no real farm measurements are claimed.
